Batch Silkscreen Typography Clean-Up

The PCB in /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb has silkscreen reference labels with inconsistent text sizes (0.8-1.5 mm), thicknesses (0.1-0.2 mm), and non-orthogonal rotations (30 deg, 45 deg). Some text also overlaps component pads. The fab team requires uniform, IPC-7351-compliant silkscreen typography before Gerber export.

Process the board and produce a cleaned output with all silkscreen fp_text elements normalized. Do not add or remove any footprints or silk text elements.

Requirements:
1. Every fp_text on F.SilkS or B.SilkS layers must have font size exactly (1.0, 1.0) mm.
2. Every silk fp_text must have font thickness exactly 0.15 mm.
3. Every silk fp_text must have a rotation angle of 0 or 90 degrees (modulo 180).
4. No silk fp_text bounding box may overlap any pad bounding box of its own footprint (tolerance 0.1 mm) - move text as needed, keeping it within 5 mm of the footprint origin.
5. All silk text must remain on F.SilkS or B.SilkS layers.
6. Total silk fp_text count must equal the count in the input file.

Write /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb.
source: IPC-2221B Generic Standard on Printed Board Design (silkscreen legibility), KiCad 9 Official Documentation — PCB Editor / Schematic Editor / CLI
